queries:
WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS group_rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
)
SELECT
  AlbumId,
  group_rate - (SELECT AVG(group_rate) FROM album_rates) AS signed_difference
FROM album_rates
ORDER BY signed_difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH album_rates AS (
    SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS rate
    FROM Track
    GROUP BY AlbumId
),
benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate
    FROM album_rates
    WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    ar.AlbumId,
    ar.rate,
    b.average_rate,
    ar.rate - b.average_rate AS rate_difference
FROM album_rates AS ar
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
ORDER BY ar.rate DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) - (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS RateDifference
FROM Track
GROUP BY AlbumId
ORDER BY RateDifference DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS GroupRate,
    (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice)
     FROM Track
     WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL
       AND UnitPrice IS NOT NULL) AS AlbumTrackAverage
FROM Track
GROUP BY AlbumId
ORDER BY GroupRate DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH album_rates AS (
    SELECT
        t.AlbumId,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN il.InvoiceLineId IS NOT NULL THEN t.TrackId END) * 1.0
            / COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) AS rate
    FROM Track AS t
    LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    WHERE t.AlbumId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.AlbumId
)
SELECT AlbumId, rate
FROM album_rates
WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM album_rates)
LIMIT 10;
